performance.verdict: CPL collapse is a delivery crisis masked by green score — SOW unbuilt.

findings.text: 10 of 10 SOW milestones overdue by 5–67 days: no stack test, no GHL migration, no Meta CAPI, no search campaigns, no landing pages, no LSA — Phase 1 is unbuilt.
CPL spiked +106.64% while leads rose only +16%; spend surged +139.7%, meaning budget scaled ~8x faster than lead volume in the last 7 days.

3-day signal (Oct 3–5): spend $124.92, leads 8 (avg 2.7/day) vs prior 3 days (Sep 30–Oct 2): spend $149.73, leads 17 (avg 5.7/day). CPL degrading: ~$15.62 vs ~$8.81 — confirmed efficiency drop, not noise.
MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP consumed $669.98 of $786.72 total spend (85%) with no GHL pipeline data to confirm leads converting to booked appointments — intake leak cannot be ruled out.
GA4 sessions spiked to 117 on Oct 5 after averaging 28–46 for 4 days, with $34.95 spend and only 2 leads — session-to-lead conversion near zero that day, tracking integrity questionable.

suggestions.text: Cut MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP daily budget by 20% (~$9/day) to arrest CPL bleed confirmed over 3 days.
suggestions.monday_update: CPL rose +106.64% while spend surged +139.7%, and the 3-day signal (Oct 3–5) shows CPL at ~$15.62 vs ~$8.81 the prior 3 days — confirmed efficiency drop. Reduce MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP daily budget by 20% (~$9/day) immediately. Success check: CPL returns below $10 within 5 days (re-check Oct 11). Do not scale again until CPL holds at or below the 28-day baseline of $6.19 for 3 consecutive days.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 10 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer; no further ad scaling until stack test and GHL pipeline are live.
suggestions.monday_update: All 10 Phase 1 milestones are overdue, the earliest by 67 days (Jul 31 deadline). With no GHL pipeline data confirmed, the 127 leads captured over 28 days cannot be verified as booked appointments — the engagement's core KPI is untracked. Nacer to provide written status on stack test, GHL migration, and Meta CAPI by Oct 9. No budget increases approved on any channel until the end-to-end stack test is confirmed complete.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 session spike (117 on Oct 5, 2 leads) for repeat; flag if session-to-lead gap persists Oct 6–9.
suggestions.monday_update: On Oct 5, GA4 recorded 117 sessions against $34.95 spend and only 2 leads — an extreme conversion gap versus the prior 4-day average of 33 sessions/day. This may indicate a tracking misconfiguration or bot traffic on the landing page. Monitor Oct 6–9; if sessions again exceed 80 with fewer than 4 leads on a spend day, escalate to web/tracking team for pixel audit before next budget decision.
